mapper.insert: insert into project_record ( project_record_no, project_no, project_record_writer_no, project_record_type, project_record_title, project_record_content ) values( #{projectRecordNo}, #{projectNo}, #{projectRecordWriterNo}, #{projectRecordType}, #{projectRecordTitle}, #{projectRecordContent} )
mapper.select:
select pr.project_record_no, pr.project_record_type, pr.project_record_title, pr.project_record_writer_no, e.emp_name project_record_writer_name, pr.project_record_ctime, pr.project_record_utime, pri.issue_status project_record_issue_status
from project_record pr
join project_member pm on pr.project_record_writer_no = pm.project_member_no
join emp e on pm.emp_no = e.emp_no
left outer join project_record_issue pri on pr.project_record_no = pri.project_record_no
where pr.project_no = #{projectNo}
order by pr.project_record_no desc

select pr.project_record_no, pr.project_no, pr.project_record_type, pr.project_record_title, pr.project_record_content, pr.project_record_writer_no, writer.emp_name project_record_writer_name, pr.project_record_modifier_no, modifier.emp_name project_record_modifier_name, pr.project_record_ctime, pr.project_record_utime, pri.issue_status project_record_issue_status, pri.issue_resolution, pri.issue_resolved_at
from project_record pr
join project_member writer_pm on pr.project_record_writer_no = writer_pm.project_member_no
join emp writer on writer_pm.emp_no = writer.emp_no
left outer join project_member modifier_pm on pr.project_record_modifier_no = modifier_pm.project_member_no
left outer join emp modifier on modifier_pm.emp_no = modifier.emp_no
left outer join project_record_issue pri on pr.project_record_no = pri.project_record_no
where pr.project_record_no = #{projectRecordNo}

select 'TASK' related_type, t.task_no related_no, t.task_title related_title, t.task_status related_status
from project_record_task prt join task t on prt.task_no = t.task_no
where prt.project_record_no = #{projectRecordNo}
union all
select 'MESSAGE' related_type, cm.chat_message_no related_no, cm.chat_message_content related_title, null related_status
from project_record_message prm join chat_message cm on prm.chat_message_no = cm.chat_message_no
where prm.project_record_no = #{projectRecordNo}
union all
select 'NOTE' related_type, n.note_no related_no, n.note_title related_title, null related_status
from project_record_note prn join note n on prn.note_no = n.note_no
where prn.project_record_no = #{projectRecordNo}
union all
select 'ATTACH' related_type, a.attach_no related_no, a.attach_name related_title, null related_status
from project_record_attach pra join attach a on pra.attach_no = a.attach_no
where pra.project_record_no = #{projectRecordNo}
mapper.update: update project_record set project_record_title = #{projectRecordTitle}, project_record_content = #{projectRecordContent}, project_record_modifier_no = #{projectRecordModifierNo}, project_record_utime = systimestamp where project_record_no = #{projectRecordNo}

update project_record_issue set issue_status = 'RESOLVED', issue_resolution = #{issueResolution}, issue_resolved_at = systimestamp where project_record_no = #{projectRecordNo} and issue_status = 'OPEN'
update project_record_issue set issue_status = 'OPEN', issue_resolution = null, issue_resolved_at = null where project_record_no = #{projectRecordNo} and issue_status = 'RESOLVED'
update project_record set project_record_modifier_no = #{projectRecordModifierNo}, project_record_utime = systimestamp where project_record_no = #{projectRecordNo}
mapper.select:
select * from ( select pr.project_record_no, pr.project_record_type, pr.project_record_title,
case when dbms_lob.getlength(pr.project_record_content) > 90 then dbms_lob.substr( pr.project_record_content, 90, 1 ) || '...' else dbms_lob.substr( pr.project_record_content, 90, 1 ) end content_preview,
pr.project_record_writer_no, writer.emp_name project_record_writer_name,
pr.project_record_modifier_no, modifier.emp_name project_record_modifier_name,
pr.project_record_ctime, pr.project_record_utime,
pri.issue_status project_record_issue_status,
case when dbms_lob.getlength(pri.issue_resolution) > 90 then dbms_lob.substr( pri.issue_resolution, 90, 1 ) || '...' else dbms_lob.substr( pri.issue_resolution, 90, 1 ) end resolution_preview,
pri.issue_resolved_at,
( select count(*) from project_record_task prt where prt.project_record_no = pr.project_record_no ) + ( select count(*) from project_record_message prm where prm.project_record_no = pr.project_record_no ) + ( select count(*) from project_record_note prn where prn.project_record_no = pr.project_record_no ) + ( select count(*) from project_record_attach pra where pra.project_record_no = pr.project_record_no ) related_count,
row_number() over(
order by pr.project_record_ctime asc, pr.project_record_no asc
order by nvl( pr.project_record_utime, pr.project_record_ctime )desc, pr.project_record_no desc
order by pr.project_record_ctime desc, pr.project_record_no desc
) rn
from project_record pr
join project_member writer_pm on pr.project_record_writer_no = writer_pm.project_member_no
join emp writer on writer_pm.emp_no = writer.emp_no
left outer join project_member modifier_pm on pr.project_record_modifier_no = modifier_pm.project_member_no
left outer join emp modifier on modifier_pm.emp_no = modifier.emp_no
left outer join project_record_issue pri on pr.project_record_no = pri.project_record_no
)
where rn between #{request.beginRownum} and #{request.endRownum}
order by rn

select count(*)
from project_record pr left outer join project_record_issue pri on pr.project_record_no = pri.project_record_no

select project_record_no, related_type, related_no, related_title, related_status
from (
select related_data.*,
row_number() over ( partition by project_record_no order by related_order, related_no ) rn
from (
select prt.project_record_no, 'TASK' related_type, t.task_no related_no, t.task_title related_title, t.task_status related_status, 1 related_order
from project_record_task prt
join task t on prt.task_no = t.task_no
where prt.project_record_no in
#{recordNo}
union all
select prm.project_record_no, 'MESSAGE' related_type, cm.chat_message_no related_no, cm.chat_message_content related_title, null related_status, 2 related_order
from project_record_message prm
join chat_message cm on prm.chat_message_no = cm.chat_message_no
where prm.project_record_no in
#{recordNo}
union all
select prn.project_record_no, 'NOTE' related_type, n.note_no related_no, n.note_title related_title, null related_status, 3 related_order
from project_record_note prn
join note n on prn.note_no = n.note_no
where prn.project_record_no in
#{recordNo}
union all
select pra.project_record_no, 'ATTACH' related_type, a.attach_no related_no, a.attach_name related_title, null related_status, 4 related_order
from project_record_attach pra
join attach a on pra.attach_no = a.attach_no
where pra.project_record_no in
#{recordNo}
) related_data
)
where rn <= 3
order by project_record_no desc, rn asc

select count(*) total_count,
nvl(sum( case when pr.project_record_type = 'DECISION' then 1 else 0 end ), 0) decision_count,
nvl(sum( case when pr.project_record_type = 'ISSUE' then 1 else 0 end ), 0) issue_count,
nvl(sum( case when pr.project_record_type = 'DELIVERABLE' then 1 else 0 end ), 0) deliverable_count,
nvl(sum( case when pr.project_record_type = 'ETC' then 1 else 0 end ), 0) etc_count,
nvl(sum( case when pri.issue_status = 'OPEN' then 1 else 0 end ), 0) open_issue_count,
nvl(sum( case when pri.issue_status = 'RESOLVED' then 1 else 0 end ), 0) resolved_issue_count,
max(pr.project_record_no) keep ( dense_rank last order by pr.project_record_ctime, pr.project_record_no ) latest_record_no,
max(pr.project_record_title) keep ( dense_rank last order by pr.project_record_ctime, pr.project_record_no ) latest_record_title,
max(pr.project_record_ctime) latest_record_at
from project_record pr
left outer join project_record_issue pri on pr.project_record_no = pri.project_record_no
where pr.project_no = #{projectNo}
